disposition.title: Delete customer data
disposition.previewError: The disposition preview could not be loaded. Close this dialog and try again.
disposition.deleteDescription: This customer has no linked transactional records. The profile can be permanently deleted.
disposition.anonymizeDescription: This customer has linked records that must remain for fiscal, financial, or operational traceability. Personal fields will be irreversibly anonymized.
disposition.retentionNote: Linked records and immutable fiscal or delivery snapshots stay intact under their retention obligations. The reusable customer profile, audit payloads, and queued sync snapshots are scrubbed.
disposition.error: Unable to dispose of personal data

creditLimit.label: Credit limit
creditLimit.help: Maximum receivable balance the customer can carry. 0 means no limit.

priceTier.label: Price level
priceTier.help: Sales to this customer suggest the selected catalog price and are not flagged as manual overrides.

actions.noteTooLong: Note can have at most 240 characters

abonoModal.title: Receive payment
abonoModal.description: Record a payment against the customer balance. The amount is stored as a credit so the running balance drops.
abonoModal.amountRequired: Enter a payment amount greater than zero

adjustmentModal.title: Charge to account
adjustmentModal.description: Record a manual adjustment. Positive amount adds to the customer's balance, negative reduces it. A note is required for the audit trail.
adjustmentModal.noteRequired: A note is required for adjustments

ledger.adminOnly: Admin role required to charge adjustments

checkoutValue.storeCreditInsufficient: The customer does not have enough store credit for this payment.
